'''''Ithor Wanderer''''' was an [[Ithorian Herdship]].

==Characteristics==
''Ithor Wanderer'' was similar to almost every other [[Ithorian Herdship]], being a huge flattened ball which was designed to simulate the jungles of [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] homeworld, in a [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-worthy [[Starship/Legends|vessel]].

==History==
''Ithor Wanderer'' followed a slow course along the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].
